mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee_invitations ( invitation_id, principal_id, invited_by_principal_id, invitation_status, expires_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{invitationId}, #{principalId}, #{invitedByPrincipalId}, #{invitationStatus}, #{expiresAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM employee_invitations WHERE principal_id = #{principalId} AND invitation_status = 'PENDING' AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE employee_invitations SET invitation_status = #{newStatus}, accepted_at = CASE WHEN #{newStatus} = 'ACCEPTED' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE accepted_at END, revoked_at = CASE WHEN #{newStatus} = 'REVOKED' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE revoked_at END WHERE invitation_id = #{invitationId}
